scope: Before-fix traffic from live compiled final5 on an isolated synthetic authenticated desktop context; Chromium/WebKit/Firefox; external requests and non-GET/HEAD local mutations blocked.
provenance: Root confirmed the still-running final5 server was compiled from ce3665de while the working tree is being prepared for final6. Working-tree hash is recorded separately and is not the before-build hash.
observation: Cold-context /dashboard load plus 3000ms after rendered UI; then 3 same-page cycles: goto dashboard, reload dashboard, goto invoices, Back dashboard, Forward invoices.
limitations: Request traffic is observed in a server running concurrent authorized QA; timings are diagnostic, not quiet performance results.

Playwright response.body yields decoded bytes. gzipEstimateBytes is local gzip of decoded script content, not a measured wire gzip transfer. observedResponseBodyBytes is separately recorded from request.sizes where available.
Canceled requests/page errors during navigation are retained. Final context/browser teardown is outside the observed active-navigation interval.
No provider writes or production target. Synthetic browser theme/onboarding/consent state only.
